properties.name: camel.component.cyberark-vault.account
properties.description: The Conjur organization account, which is part of the path of every request to the Conjur REST API. Not used when the conjurClient option is set.

properties.name: camel.component.cyberark-vault.api-key
properties.description: The API key of the Conjur user or host given by the username option. The component exchanges it for an access token, and again when Conjur rejects the token. Used when the authToken option is not set.

properties.name: camel.component.cyberark-vault.auth-token
properties.description: A Conjur access token, as returned by the Conjur authenticate request, which the component sends Base64-encoded in the Authorization header. It takes precedence over apiKey and password. The component cannot renew it, so the requests fail once the token has expired.

properties.name: camel.component.cyberark-vault.autowired-enabled
properties.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

properties.name: camel.component.cyberark-vault.certificate-path
properties.description: Path of a file with the SSL certificate to trust when connecting to CyberArk Conjur, for example the certificate of a private CA, in PEM or DER format. The certificates in the file are trusted instead of the default trust store of the JVM. A path of the file system, or a resource with the file: or classpath: prefix, for example classpath:conjur-ca.pem. Other prefixes, such as http:, are not supported. Not used when verifySsl is false.

properties.name: camel.component.cyberark-vault.configuration
properties.description: The configuration that the endpoints of the component share: each endpoint starts from a copy of it. The option is a org.apache.camel.component.cyberark.vault.CyberArkVaultConfiguration type.

properties.name: camel.component.cyberark-vault.conjur-client
properties.description: To use a custom ConjurClient, for example #myClient from the registry. When set, the url, account, credential and SSL options are not used, and the endpoint does not close the client. The option is a org.apache.camel.component.cyberark.vault.client.ConjurClient type.

properties.name: camel.component.cyberark-vault.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable auto configuration of the cyberark-vault component. This is enabled by default.

properties.name: camel.component.cyberark-vault.lazy-start-producer
properties.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

properties.name: camel.component.cyberark-vault.operation
properties.description: The operation that the producer performs. getSecret reads the value of the secret into the message body. createSecret stores the message body, or the CamelCyberArkVaultSecretValue header, as a new value of a variable that is declared in Conjur policy. The CamelCyberArkVaultOperation header replaces this option.

properties.name: camel.component.cyberark-vault.password
properties.description: The password of the Conjur user, used with the username option when neither authToken nor apiKey is set. The component sends it in the Conjur authenticate request, in place of an API key.

properties.name: camel.component.cyberark-vault.secret-id
properties.description: The ID of the secret, which is the ID of a Conjur variable, for example db/password. If not set on the endpoint, the value of the URI path is used. The CamelCyberArkVaultSecretId header replaces this option.

properties.name: camel.component.cyberark-vault.url
properties.description: The base URL of the Conjur server, for example https://conjur.example.com. The component appends the paths of the Conjur REST API, such as /authn and /secrets, to it. Not used when the conjurClient option is set.

properties.name: camel.component.cyberark-vault.username
properties.description: The login of the Conjur user or host to authenticate as, for example admin or host/myapp. It is used together with the apiKey option or the password option.

properties.name: camel.component.cyberark-vault.verify-ssl
properties.description: Whether to verify the SSL certificate and the host name of the CyberArk Conjur server. Setting it to false trusts any server, so use it only for testing.
